vehicle.scope: This checkout and these sessions only; not a universal Alfa Romeo or cross-model DBC.

byte_convention: Zero-based byte indexes; bit 0 is LSB. Parts are concatenated in listed most-significant-first order; physical = raw * scale + offset.
capture_limits: RX capture only; own firmware TX is not recorded.
No IDE/RTR flag in binary records; do not infer these flags from a shared numeric ID.
Host timestamps are receipt times and batch across USB; board clocks have no common epoch.
Startup loss counts can saturate at 65535.
Frame presence or firmware implementation is not independent physical validation.

messages.title: IPC text fragments
messages.note: Transport length is last index + 1. Source context is the last observed text context, not a guaranteed live audio-source selector. UTF-16BE-compatible packing; IPC glyph/surrogate support is not established. The MY23 UI candidate transmits selected BMP glyphs as 14 padded characters, CR, 22 padded characters and two trailing spaces (13 fragments); legacy remains variable-length L1 plus its footer. Factory text field lengths remain variable. These captured sessions contain RX, not this candidate's BH TX, so they do not prove its visible alignment. Current firmware defaults to immutable complete screen passes (Full); RAM-only Delta retains changed-fragment transmission. Menu fragment pacing is 50 ms by default, with temporary 20/10 ms choices and a five-second BH lease. These implementation options do not change the frame bit layout or establish timing/visibility in historical RX captures.

messages.title: Steering-wheel cruise/menu pad
messages.note: 0x50 is normalized to 0x90 only by the menu input recognizer. In this MY23 UI candidate, released clicks >=30 ms form BACK pairs within 280 ms; a continuous >=900 ms hold opens the closed menu or executes a displayed SAVE/APPLY/STORE prompt. Release arming, stream freshness and CC/ACC gates still apply. Earlier recordings used the legacy >=1200 ms hold-BACK behavior; retained CAN-derived hold markers describe those recordings. RX does not prove that the menu acted or appeared.

research_findings.detail: BH 0x46C byte 6 bits 2..1: 0 center, 1 right, 2 left in code and 20260926-182645Z. ON labels in 181818Z show opposite-side values; two left cycles also use right_indicator_off labels. Do not relabel or train automatically.

C1 0x4B1 byte 0 bit 0 follows four marked transitions in 182645Z and four more in 204100Z; 181818Z and two earlier windows contain no matching transition. Comment interpretation is supported across two sessions, not universally validated.
C2 0x1F5 byte 4 raw pressure: 9 of 10 manual brake markers across two sessions match threshold transitions (-3..+1 s). No calibrated pressure unit; lamp blink states are not pedal state.
BH 0x090: 3 complete 0x21 messages in 182645Z and 33 complete 0x06 messages in 185147Z. Bluetooth 0x09 is a current-code test option, not independently captured here.

13 long select/back holds in 185147Z have zero overlapping factory 0x090 RX frames, while BH still receives other frames. This rules out continuous new radio text during those intervals, not a prior overwrite, expired display state or missing BACCAble TX.

IBS 0x41A reports 77..79% in Sept 26-27 sessions and 84% on Sept 28. Positive ECM 0x19BD responses occur in earlier sessions; BCM 0x1005 replies were not decoded in these recordings. Sources must remain distinct.
No dedicated manual interventions identify rain or wiper signals. C2 0x1FC is reference-only; packet presence does not validate damping codes.

Parameter IDs 50..53 are not-implemented catalog entries: request PCI is 2 despite 22+two DID bytes, and their reply offset exceeds the single-frame decoder capacity. This dictionary records the discrepancy; no firmware behavior is changed.
